upload:
# C152 WORLD parameter predictor / 2026-11-13
# この末尾の専用セルだけを実行する。
from google.colab import files
world_upload = files.upload()
run:
# WORLD入力照合・専用環境の準備・上限付き学習
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, io, json, os, subprocess, sys, zipfile
world_blob = world_upload['irodori-world-input-20261113.zip']
assert hashlib.sha256(world_blob).hexdigest() == '6c8b732c7ddcc2d888c8e33a0f82867666fc241f6e4ae82d7221c134a3f1d815'
world_root = Path('/content/sumi_world_20261113')
world_input = world_root / 'input'
world_input.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(world_blob)) as archive:
    assert all((world_input/n).resolve().is_relative_to(world_input.resolve()) for n in archive.namelist())
    archive.extractall(world_input)
for name, expected in json.loads((world_input/'SHA256.json').read_text()).items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((world_input/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
print('WORLD_INPUT_VERIFIED', len(world_blob))
world_env = world_root/'venv'
subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'venv', '--system-site-packages', str(world_env)], check=True, timeout=60)
world_python = world_env/'bin/python'
subprocess.run([str(world_python), '-m', 'pip', 'install', '--no-deps', 'pyworld==0.3.5', 'setuptools==80.9.0'], check=True, timeout=240)
subprocess.run([str(world_python), '-m', 'unittest', 'discover', '-s', str(world_input), '-p', 'test*world.py', '-v'], check=True, timeout=45)
subprocess.run(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'], check=True)
world_log = world_root/'training.log'
with world_log.open('x') as log:
    world_process = subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','360s',str(world_python),'-u',str(world_input/'train_world.py'),'--data',str(world_input/'data'),'--output',str(world_root/'output'),'--device','cuda','--steps','5000','--max-seconds','240'], stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('WORLD_TRAINING_STARTED',world_process.pid)
status:
# 学習の状態確認
print('WORLD_RETURN_CODE', world_process.poll())
print(world_log.read_text()[-2200:])
if (world_root/'output/completed.json').exists():
    print((world_root/'output/completed.json').read_text())
setup_recovery:
# Colab標準Pythonにvenv用部品がないため、依存を専用フォルダへ配置する。
assert not (world_root/'output').exists()
for name, expected in json.loads((world_input/'SHA256.json').read_text()).items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((world_input/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
world_deps = world_root/'deps'
setup_result = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-m','pip','install','--target',str(world_deps),'--no-deps','pyworld==0.3.5','setuptools==80.9.0'],text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=240)
(world_root/'setup.log').write_text(setup_result.stdout)
print(setup_result.stdout[-2500:])
setup_result.check_returncode()
world_python = Path(sys.executable)
world_env_vars = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH=str(world_deps))
test_result = subprocess.run([str(world_python),'-m','unittest','discover','-s',str(world_input),'-p','test*world.py','-v'],env=world_env_vars,text=True,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=45)
(world_root/'tests.log').write_text(test_result.stdout)
print(test_result.stdout[-3000:])
test_result.check_returncode()
print(subprocess.check_output(['nvidia-smi','--query-gpu=name,memory.total','--format=csv,noheader'],text=True))
world_log = world_root/'training.log'
with world_log.open('x') as log:
    world_process = subprocess.Popen(['timeout','--signal=TERM','--kill-after=10s','360s',str(world_python),'-u',str(world_input/'train_world.py'),'--data',str(world_input/'data'),'--output',str(world_root/'output'),'--device','cuda','--steps','5000','--max-seconds','240'],env=world_env_vars,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
print('WORLD_TRAINING_STARTED',world_process.pid)
